Image 1 is a 3D blocking render (white model). Use it only as the layout guide: keep its camera position, framing and the place of every object.

- The blue block is a tall potted plant.

The boxes in Image 1 are only position markers: do not draw any box or flat plastic shading, no text, no watermark.
